Alger, 3 septembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, September 3, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Mohamed Sellam, Head of Technological Infrastructure at Djezzy, will participate in LEAP 2026 to discuss open innovation and strategic partnerships. The operator will showcase its solutions during the program dedicated to the Algerian ecosystem.
Mohamed Sellam, chef de l'infrastructure: Mohamed Sellam, Head of Technological Infrastructure at Djezzy, will speak at the LEAP 2026 business conference. His presentation will focus on the challenges of open innovation and strategic partnerships in the telecommunications sector.
Djezzy Solutions, filiale du groupe, rej: Djezzy Solutions, a subsidiary of the group, will also join Algeria's LEAP program. The stated objective is to showcase the technological solutions developed by the operator and interact with the local innovative ecosystem. This participation is part of an initiative aimed at contributing to the development of digital commerce in Algeria.
Les échanges et présentations seront acc: Discussions and presentations will be accessible live via streaming on the YouTube platform. The link to the event is available: https://www.youtube.com/live/-Hz94KAkEDc?si=10lGw2WnkSYPlGGC.
